page_title: TOU 1-1 MON | Toulouse v Monaco 07/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.

90+3' Miha Zajc (Toulouse) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the top left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Radoslaw Majecki, who pulls off a stunning save!
90+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Frank Magri (Toulouse) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:1.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Yellow card! It's like Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Marc Bollengier agrees and books him.
89' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Radoslaw Majecki comes off the line to clear the ball away.

88' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) strikes with a bullet header after a well-executed corner kick deep into the box. The ball goes close to the right post, but is superbly blocked and deflected onto the post by the goalkeeper.
87' Lamine Camara (Monaco) is about to take a corner kick.
86' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
84' Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.
84' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) swings in a cross from the corner, but Radoslaw Majecki reads it well and gathers the ball.
84' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Good work from Toulouse as they win a corner.
82' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Wilfried Singo (Monaco) replacing Mika Biereth.
81' Substitution. Shavy Babicka walks off the pitch and Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) comes on as a substitute.
81' Toulouse seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
76' Toulouse are ruled offside.
74' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Takumi Minamino and he is replaced by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
74' Substitution. Breel Embolo will be replaced by George Ilenikhena (Monaco).
74' Breel Embolo (Monaco) gets a yellow card.
74' Breel Embolo (Monaco) covers his face with his hands after wasting a glorious chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went a whisker wide of the left post.
73' It will be a corner kick for Monaco.
71' Mika Biereth (Monaco) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
71' Substitution. Miha Zajc (Toulouse) has come on for Jaydee Canvot.
70' What a save from Radoslaw Majecki! Frank Magri (Toulouse) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
69' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) and Vincent Sierro matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
66' Lamine Camara (Monaco) is able to continue to play.
64' The game is interrupted now, Lamine Camara (Monaco) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
63' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Monaco.
62' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
59' Carles Martinez decides to make a substitution. Rafik Messali will be replaced by Yann Gboho (Toulouse).
58' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) tackles a bit over-zealously and Marc Bollengier blows for a foul.
55' The ball is cleared after Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Kjetil Haug comes off the line to clear the ball away.
49' Monaco are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Monaco have a free kick.
45+1' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
43' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
41' The game is interrupted.

40' A cross by Lamine Camara (Monaco) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
37' Breel Embolo (Monaco) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
35' Breel Embolo (Monaco) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' 0:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
29' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Lamine Camara (Monaco).
27' The ball goes out of play. Monaco are awarded a corner kick.

27' Lamine Camara (Monaco) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Kjetil Haug blocks the shot with his legs.
26' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
22' Monaco have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
22' Great teamplay by Monaco as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
18' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Monaco players have a reason to celebrate!
17' Monaco score a goal, but referee Marc Bollengier has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
17' 0 - 1 Goal! Mika Biereth puts the ball on a plate for Takumi Minamino (Monaco), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 0:1.

16' Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marc Bollengier blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
13' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar.

10' Mika Biereth (Monaco) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Kjetil Haug inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
8' Lamine Camara (Monaco) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
6' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Toulouse for a penalty. Play continues.
4' Mika Biereth (Monaco) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
1' Christian Mawissa Elebi (Monaco) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Monaco will kick the game off.
Marc Bollengier is the one to supervise the game today.
